answer: Agents may wander between juniper surveys and knoll mapping, but jury weight should follow locked stake. Each stake unit gets one ticket for the full jury term. After locks are fixed, draw tickets uniformly without replacement using unpredictable randomness; one key may hold several winning tickets. Splitting a balance across aliases leaves the weight distribution unchanged. An attacker seeking a third of expected jury weight must lock a third of eligible stake. This limits alias leverage, assuming enforced locks and unbiased randomness.
